g.text: Can an LLM find out why a network fails on
share of ECGs that carry the artifact
so the network learns “artifact means MI”
It works clearly worse on unseen
data, above all for heart attacks
(MI). Find out why, and fix it by
the cause, its evidence, where it acts
MI detection on unseen test ECGs, against
fine-tuning and a last-layer refit on the same
